reason: The cited code validates each requested path, reads file contents with fs.readFile, and returns those contents in the tool response, which supports SECRET because host file data is returned. It does not show arbitrary code execution or delivery of data to an attacker-readable external destination, so HOSTEXEC and SINK are not supported. The response also includes caller-supplied path strings, and potentially file contents from caller-chosen paths, so it returns attacker-controllable content, supporting UNTRUSTED.
